summary: This standards-track document specifies how DNS should treat queries for names ending in home.arpa and designates it as a special-use domain name. It is meant for non-unique use in residential home networks, and it was produced as part of the Homenet work. It gives home devices a place to use local names without clashing with the public DNS.

eli5.summary: Every house can have its own little names, like 'kitchen printer.' This reserves a special name ending so those home names do not mix with real websites.

questions: what domain should i use for home networks
